Downtown & East Town.name: Downtown & East Town
Downtown & East Town.description: Lakefront central business district with the Deer District, arena-adjacent hospitality, and dense bar/restaurant license activity.

Bay View.name: Bay View
Bay View.description: South-side historic mill district with a strong independent tavern and restaurant corridor along Kinnickinnic Avenue.

Walker's Point.name: Walker's Point
Walker's Point.description: South-of-downtown food-and-beverage hub with concentrated liquor license turnover and adaptive reuse of industrial buildings.

Riverwest & Brewers Hill.name: Riverwest & Brewers Hill
Riverwest & Brewers Hill.description: North-side river neighborhoods with neighborhood taverns, music venues, and owner-operator license density.

Westown & Washington Heights.name: Westown & Washington Heights
Westown & Washington Heights.description: West-side corridor with mixed commercial-residential stock and steady service-sector license renewal activity.
